verdict.rationale: Gemini's built-in assistant supports delegated task execution: connected apps to take actions across Gmail/Calendar/third-party apps, scheduled recurring actions, Deep Research for autonomous multi-step research, Gems for custom task agents, and Gemini Live/Daily Brief for proactive assistance. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of end-to-end task delegation reliability, and some agentic actions are gated behind permissions/account type limitations (docs-33, docs-35).
